purpose: Teach: 盧/洲/卿/大王/艦長/豪州/ムスリム/キリスト教徒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、韓国の盧氏系列との取引を慎重に進めろ
lines.en: We need to proceed carefully with our dealings through the Roh corporate family network in Korea.
lines.style: Measured directorial tone. Even cadence on the instruction. Slight pause before 'carefully'—emphasis on discretion. Composed authority without hardness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧満洲国洲時代の社史を電子化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll digitise our company history from the Manchukuo era.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with quiet efficiency. Quick, professional delivery. A slight nod in the voice—showing he's already thinking about the work ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、英国卿位の取引先を大事にしろ
lines.en: And make sure we value our client relationships with the British nobility.
lines.style: Calm, authoritative continuation. Weight on 'value'—this is principle, not transaction. Steady eye-contact level throughout. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品のブランド名を「大王」に決定します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've decided on 'Daiou'—the Great King—as the new product brand name.
lines.style: Clear, assured report. Slight lift on the brand name reveal—this is a decision made. Professional pride in the work, delivered matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、輸送船の艦長級スタッフを尊重しろ
lines.en: We must also respect the expertise of our senior maritime logistics personnel.
lines.style: Formal but purposeful. Deliberate pace on 'respect.' The word carries weight—this is about honouring skill and experience, not mere formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。豪州、つまりオーストラリア市場の調査を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'm advancing our market research in Australia—that is, the Australian market.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Quick and methodical. The clarification on 'Australia' is matter-of-fact, not apologetic—he knows exactly what he's doing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ムスリム圏の市場開拓を進めろ
lines.en: Expand our market presence in the Muslim world.
lines.style: Direct, weighted instruction. Short sentence length—no elaboration needed. Authority without condescension. Clear priority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。キリスト教徒の祝祭日にも配慮した商品展開をします
lines.en: Yes. We'll roll out products that also respect Christian holy days—showing consideration across faith communities.
lines.style: Thoughtful, inclusive delivery. Warm undertone beneath the professional register. A slight emphasis on 'respect'—this reflects values, not just business strategy.
